scope: Primary RFC check for the controlled QEMU capture classifier; no general IPv6 conformance or new QEMU result

sources.facts: Hop-by-Hop headers carry the following protocol and bounded option lengths. The classifier supports a stricter observed subset and rejects other extension chains.
MLDv2 reports are ICMPv6 control with Hop Limit1 and Router Alert in a Hop-by-Hop header. The real captures use link-local source addresses.
Router/neighbor solicitation and neighbor advertisement use code0 and Hop Limit255; message lengths and ICMPv6 checksums matter.

method: Opened official RFC Editor pages and located the relevant requirements; no RFC code or prose transplanted.
